svg.text: Bookmarks and notes — ⚑ mark a moment in Live, find it in the review (DESIGN_Bookmarks_And_Notes.md)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
① Live — B marks the moment at once; the ⚑ appears on every station's timeline
⚑ = a checkpoint (built) · the amber dot = it has a note · hover: name, note, unit, who · double-click: seek (in DAR / AAR)
② B — the moment is taken at the key press; this asks only for the optional words
closes by itself in 4 s — the mark stays
Esc / ignoring it keeps an unnamed mark ("Mark 3 · 12:31")
B is greyed in an unrecorded Live: "no recording — nothing to mark"
③ Marks — every host with a timeline (Live · DAR · AAR)
click: seek there (and select the unit) · right-click: Edit note · Restart from here (a ⚑ only) · Delete the note
⚑ = a mark taken in Live (a checkpoint)
the amber note = added in the AAR: a time only, not restorable (R-4168) — Q2
